Pass 1 independently inspected HEAD 0a47f4cedb8be4c0e9ac087f7316b86165496df8 against base 1c6397c740d9b64fab471a40f493c6f6acd10bcc, read the complete diff and touched files, and made no edits; criterion verdicts: AC-4 SATISFIED in implementation (src/math.mjs:68-72, product([2,3,4]) = 24 and validation with no mutation), R-1 SATISFIED in implementation (src/math.mjs:69-71), R-2 SATISFIED (src/math.mjs:72 and test/math.test.mjs:96-99), R-3 SATISFIED (diff preserves src/math.mjs:1-66 and existing test/math.test.mjs:5-83 with only the allowed import change at line 3), R-4 SATISFIED (complete diff changes only src/math.mjs and test/math.test.mjs, with no dependency or generated-file changes), and R-5 SATISFIED (test/math.test.mjs:85,88,91,96 all use the product prefix).

Checks actually run: node --test --test-name-pattern="^product" test/ exited 0 with "tests 4", "pass 4", "fail 0"; npm test exited 1 with "tests 19", "pass 18", "fail 1" and only "clamp respects upper bound" failing at test/math.test.mjs:14 (15 !== 10), the explicitly permitted unchanged baseline failure; an independent in-memory validation matrix and frozen-input check exited 0 with "PASS: independent validation matrix and frozen-input product" after an initial here-document invocation was blocked by the read-only shell temporary-file restriction; git status --short was empty; remaining work is candidate test coverage repair, with no unresolved implementation uncertainty within the reviewed scope and final acceptance reserved to the coordinator.
